# EUR-Lex fixtures

Unmodified excerpts of the EUR-Lex HTML documents listed in `data/sources.toml`, used as parser
test input. Each file names its source CELEX number and the case it covers in a comment at
the top. © European Union, reused under Decision 2011/833/EU (see `docs/data-licenses.md`).

`oj_*` files use the Official Journal layout, `cons_*` files the consolidated layout.
